Mskamal1.title: Go data/ML platform
Mskamal1.description: Ingest, pipeline, train, serve: a Go data/ML platform with two interchangeable serving backends (pure Go and ONNX Runtime) that are parity-tested against each other.

Mskamal2.title: Frameforge
Mskamal2.description: A responsive creator-asset workspace that turns a raw video script into a reviewable YouTube publishing kit: titles, descriptions, chapters and thumbnail directions, with deterministic validation.

Mskamal3.title: This portfolio
Mskamal3.description: The site you are looking at: a dependency-free static page that renders my public GitHub projects live, with a saved snapshot as a fallback.

Mskamal4.title: Singularity
Mskamal4.description: An interactive, real-time Three.js visualization of a stellar-mass black hole, with a glowing accretion disk, gravitational lensing and controls for mass and orbital speed.

Mskamal5.title: devicecheck
Mskamal5.description: A dependency-free Python CLI that compares Android phone properties with documented reference profiles. Strictly read-only.
